cards.dailyOrbitDesc: Complete 10 tiered math questions between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM to earn up to 17 SP + 5 AC.
cards.superNovaDesc: Sharpen speed and visual focus in Super Sight and Super Warp sprints.
cards.starDuelsDesc: Challenge classmates, your Star Crew, or a random pilot with 3 energy cells per day.
cards.galaxyTrainingDesc: Master Kurikulum Merdeka, Singapore MOE, Cambridge 0096, Challenging Maths, HOTS, and Real-World Explorer Series.

cards.planetStoriesDesc: Explore 6 grade planets and unlock 20-page illustrated math storybooks with Astro Coins.
